instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application is a single page application using Tailwind and pure HTML elements for marketing layouts. Follow the typography hierarchy strictly and use generous paddings. Do not use generic Inter font for headings. Ensure buttons use the hover states described. Testimonial section needs mobile-first responsive layout. Make sure to embed all image URLs precisely without placeholders. Include data-testid on interactive elements. Apply the fonts globally in the layout file. Add smooth scrolling using standard css or framer-motion.
